description: A colouring of the n-element subsets of X into an empty colour set exists exactly when there are no n-element subsets of X.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.empty_color_domain_iff.{u} (α : Type u) (n : ℕ) :
  Nonempty (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.Coloring α n (Fin 0)) ↔
    IsEmpty (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.Subsets α n)
